findings.fix: Rewrite explicitly, e.g. `rwa [AddMonoid.exponent_additive]` (or `simpa [AddMonoid.exponent_additive] using hcop`), instead of closing by defeq.
findings.issue: In `map_subtype_quotientConjugation_injective_of_coprime_index_exponent`, `exact hcop` relies on `AddMonoid.exponent (Additive N)` being definitionally `Monoid.exponent N`; the comment names `AddMonoid.exponent_additive` but the proof does not use it.

findings.evidence: grep for `Additive` in mathlib/Mathlib/GroupTheory/PGroup.lean finds no such lemma; the proof's own comment says the equality is 'definitionally' true.
findings.fix: Add a lemma in TauCeti/GroupTheory/PGroup.lean (e.g. `IsPGroup.additive : IsPGroup p G → IsAddPGroup p (Additive G)`, or an iff) and use it here instead of the defeq coercion.
findings.issue: In `IsPGroup.map_subtype_quotientConjugation_sylow_injective`, `have hA : IsAddPGroup p (Rep.ofMulDistribMulAction (G ⧸ N) N) := hN` converts `IsPGroup p N` to `IsAddPGroup p` on the representation carrier purely by unfolding through `Additive` and the `Rep` carrier.

findings.evidence: Diff lines: `rw [Rep.nsmul_hom, Representation.IntertwiningMap.coe_nsmul, Pi.smul_apply, Rep.hom_id]; exact hA a`.
findings.fix: Replace with `simpa using hA a` (or a single `simp only [...]` set) after `Rep.hom_ext <| DFunLike.ext _ _ fun a ↦`.
findings.issue: In `nsmul_eq_zero_of_forall_nsmul_eq_zero`, `h0` is built from a four-step named-lemma `rw` chain (`Rep.nsmul_hom`, `Representation.IntertwiningMap.coe_nsmul`, `Pi.smul_apply`, `Rep.hom_id`) that breaks on any Mathlib rename.

summary: Two proofs move hypotheses through the `Additive` wrapper by relying on definitional equality instead of an explicit lemma, and one proof uses a brittle chain of named rewrites.
